_comment: Signal Decay — REVEAL LAYERS manifest. Each story can gain optional media layers OVER TIME without touching the story text or anyone's saved progress. The reader always renders the text first; layers are a BONUS, never a wall. Old app versions ignore layer types they don't understand. Fetched network-first (fresh online, cached offline), merged over baked-in defaults. Add media by editing this file — same drop-switch workflow can edit it.

_schema.hero: URL of a wide illustration shown at the top of the story (optional). Use a content-hashed/immutable filename e.g. art/dt_first_octave.a1b2c3.jpg
_schema.ambient: { src: URL to a looping ambient audio bed, label: short name }. Off by default; the reader shows a subtle 'Play ambience' toggle.
_schema.gallery: [ {src,caption} ] extra illustrations shown at the end (optional).
_schema.motion: reserved for future motion-comic data — ignored by current clients

_ambient_todo: To add ambient audio to any of these: drop an .mp3 in audio/ and add e.g. "ambient": {"src":"audio/<name>.v1.mp3","label":"..."} beside the hero. (No audio-gen tool available, so tracks must be supplied.)
